import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.nunique(), w.year.isna().sum(), w.year.min(), w.year.max())
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']).copy()
w['late']=w.year>=1876
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).dropna().mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs={k:v for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(2000):
  d=pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in gs.values()])
  bs.append(est(d))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']:
  print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('excl1870s', est(w[(w.year<1866)|(w.year>=1886)]))
print('origin', {o:est(w[w.origin==o]) for o in w.origin.unique()})
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
print(w[w[c]>0].query('late').passage_ids.head(4).tolist(), w[w[c]>0].query('not late').passage_ids.head(2).tolist())
"
